g.text: «Strategy» SpreadModel: the engine asks it for per-cell
ignition probabilities every tick. Wildland sessions use
sessions use UrbanSpreadModel (+ intensity, ember spotting).
observers before/after every tick and on reset, so the
city layer plugs in without the engine importing it.
«state machine» SimState, guarded by the engine:
step() advances one tick and pauses; reset() -> IDLE.
«Factory» create_session() builds a wildland or city
re-runs the seeded scenario rather than restoring one.
Grey class: defined in the city-layer diagram.
